cards.english_title: Cyclone Murasu heads toward Andhra Pradesh
cards.korean_desc: 사이클론 무라수는 2026년 11월 1일 강해졌습니다. 폭풍은 11월 2일 넬로르에서 160킬로미터 떨어졌습니다. 무라수는 11월 2일 밤 넬로르와 나라사푸르 사이를 지날 수 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: Cyclone Murasu intensified over the Bay of Bengal on November 1, 2026. The storm was about 160 kilometers from Nellore on November 2. It may cross between Nellore and Narsapur late November 2 or early November 3.
cards.hook: Cyclone Murasu is heading toward Andhra Pradesh.
cards.takeaway_english: Officials are watching the landfall window while residents prepare for heavy rain and strong winds.
cards.takeaway_korean: 당국은 상륙 시간을 지켜보며 주민들은 폭우와 강풍에 대비합니다.

why_it_matters.english: Storm warnings can affect schools, flights, fishing, travel, and emergency services.
why_it_matters.korean: 폭풍 경보는 학교, 항공, 어업과 여행에 영향을 줍니다.

why_it_matters.english: Evacuation timing can reduce danger in low-lying and vulnerable areas.
why_it_matters.korean: 빠른 대피는 위험 지역의 피해를 줄일 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Odisha government
parties.english: It is speeding up evacuations from vulnerable areas.

parties.label: Andhra Pradesh
parties.english: The coast is expected to receive the storm.

parties.label: Passengers
parties.english: Cancelled flights are disrupting travel through Chennai and Vijayawada.

views.label: India Meteorological Department
views.english: The storm may cross between Nellore and Narsapur from late November 2 to early November 3.

views.label: AP disaster officials
views.english: Official alerts and preparedness measures show a focus on reducing risk before landfall.
views.korean: 재난 당국은 상륙 전 위험을 줄이려 합니다.

disagree.english: Forecast paths and rainfall can change, so the final impact remains uncertain.
disagree.korean: 진로와 강우량은 바뀔 수 있어 영향은 아직 불확실합니다.

cards.english_title: India’s factory growth cools, but remains strong
cards.korean_desc: 인도 제조업 PMI가 55.1에서 54.7로 떨어졌습니다. 생산과 신규 주문은 늘었지만 속도는 느려졌습니다. 강한 해외 수요가 수출 주문 증가를 6개월 최고로 올렸습니다. 10월 수치는 50을 넘어 계속 성장했습니다.
cards.english_desc: India’s manufacturing PMI fell from 55.1 in September to 54.7 in October. Output and new orders still rose, but both increased more slowly. Strong overseas demand lifted export-order growth to a six-month high. The October reading stayed above 50, showing continued expansion.
cards.takeaway_english: India’s factories are still expanding, but confidence and hiring need closer attention.
cards.takeaway_korean: 인도 공장은 성장하지만 자신감과 채용은 지켜봐야 합니다.

why_it_matters.english: Factory activity can affect jobs, export income, prices, and supply chains.
why_it_matters.korean: 공장 활동은 일자리와 수출, 가격에 영향을 줍니다.

why_it_matters.english: Lower cost pressure may reduce some pressure on producers and buyers.
why_it_matters.korean: 비용 압력 완화는 생산자와 구매자를 도울 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Indian manufacturers
parties.english: They increased output, orders, jobs, and inventories, but more slowly.

parties.label: Export businesses
parties.english: Strong international demand pushed export-order growth to a six-month high.
parties.korean: 강한 해외 수요가 수출 주문을 높였습니다.

parties.label: Workers
parties.english: Factory employment rose for a second month, though hiring slowed.

views.label: HSBC economist Pranjul Bhandari
views.english: The sector remains firmly in expansion, supported by exports and rising production.
views.korean: 제조업은 수출과 생산 증가로 계속 성장 중입니다.

views.label: The Financial Economy analysis
views.english: Large inventories could become a problem if demand weakens after the festive season.
views.korean: 수요가 줄면 많은 재고가 문제가 될 수 있습니다.

disagree.english: A reading above 50 shows growth, but it does not prove every factory or worker is doing better.
disagree.korean: 50을 넘었다고 모든 공장과 노동자가 좋아진 것은 아닙니다.

cards.english_title: The X-47 Venom goes faster and lighter
cards.korean_desc: 울트라바이올렛이 개선된 X-47 베놈을 공개했습니다. 새 플랫폼은 무게 없이 출력과 충전을 개선합니다. 모터는 30킬로와트를 내고 100킬로미터까지 5.9초입니다. 주행거리는 343킬로미터지만 실제 거리는 조건에 달렸습니다.
cards.english_desc: Ultraviolette introduced the upgraded X-47 Venom electric motorcycle. The new platform aims to improve power delivery, charging, and efficiency without adding weight. Its motor produces 30kW, while claimed 0–100km/h acceleration takes 5.9 seconds. The claimed range is 343 kilometers, but real distance depends on riding conditions.
cards.hook: The X-47 Venom adds speed, technology, and range.
cards.takeaway_english: The Venom looks ambitious, but everyday riding will test the claims.
cards.takeaway_korean: 베놈은 야심 차지만 실제 주행이 주장을 시험합니다.

why_it_matters.english: A lighter electric motorcycle may be easier to use in traffic and corners.
why_it_matters.korean: 가벼운 전기 오토바이는 도로와 코너에서 더 쉬울 수 있습니다.

why_it_matters.english: Battery cooling and safety systems matter during demanding rides.
why_it_matters.korean: 배터리 냉각과 안전 장치는 힘든 주행에 중요합니다.

parties.label: Ultraviolette
parties.english: It claims stronger performance, improved cooling, and a lighter motorcycle.

parties.label: Riders
parties.english: They may get easier handling and faster acceleration from the lighter design.
parties.korean: 라이더는 더 쉬운 조작과 빠른 가속을 얻을 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Electric motorcycle buyers
parties.english: They must treat the claimed range as a laboratory figure, not a promise.
parties.korean: 구매자는 주행거리를 실험실 수치로 봐야 합니다.

views.label: The Hindu review
views.english: The Venom looks distinctive and combines performance with useful technology upgrades.
views.korean: 베놈은 독특하고 성능과 기술을 함께 높였습니다.

views.label: Official specification sheet
views.english: Ultraviolette lists 30kW power, 2.7-second 0–60km/h acceleration, and a 145km/h top speed.

disagree.english: Real range, handling, and performance can differ from company claims in daily riding.
disagree.korean: 실제 주행거리와 성능은 회사 주장과 다를 수 있습니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 속도, 주행거리, 쉬운 조작 중 무엇이 더 중요한가요?

cards.english_title: Namibia wins its first ODI series against a Full Member
cards.korean_desc: 나미비아가 2026년 11월 1일 빈트후크에서 이겼습니다. 이번 승리는 정회원국 상대 첫 ODI 시리즈 승리였습니다. 나미비아는 아일랜드를 129점에 잡고 131점을 냈습니다. 나미비아는 남아공과 짐바브웨와 내년 월드컵을 공동 개최합니다.
cards.english_desc: Namibia defeated Ireland by five wickets in Windhoek on November 1, 2026. The result gave Namibia its first bilateral ODI series win over a Full Member nation. Namibia bowled Ireland out for 129 before reaching 131 for five. Namibia will co-host next year’s World Cup with South Africa and Zimbabwe.
cards.hook: Namibia beat Ireland 3–2 in a historic ODI series.
cards.takeaway_english: Namibia has made history, but the next challenge is qualifying and competing at the World Cup.
cards.takeaway_korean: 나미비아는 역사를 썼지만 월드컵 진출과 경쟁이 다음 과제입니다.

why_it_matters.english: The result gives Namibia confidence before a major home-region World Cup.
why_it_matters.korean: 이번 결과는 큰 월드컵을 앞두고 나미비아에 자신감을 줍니다.

why_it_matters.english: Ireland’s batting collapse shows how quickly a match can turn.
why_it_matters.korean: 아일랜드의 타격 붕괴는 경기 흐름이 빨리 바뀜을 보여줍니다.

parties.label: Namibia
parties.english: It won its first bilateral ODI series against a Full Member nation.
parties.korean: 나미비아는 처음으로 정회원국과 ODI 시리즈를 이겼습니다.

parties.label: Ireland
parties.english: It struggled with the bat in the deciding match.

parties.label: Gerhard Erasmus
parties.english: He made 263 runs and took four wickets across the series.

views.label: Namibia
views.english: The victory is a major boost before the 2027 World Cup, which Namibia will co-host.
views.korean: 이번 승리는 2027년 공동 개최 월드컵을 앞둔 큰 힘입니다.

views.label: Ireland captain Lorcan Tucker
views.english: Ireland lacked the necessary skills for long periods and must reflect.
views.korean: 아일랜드는 오랫동안 필요한 기술을 보여주지 못했습니다.

disagree.english: One series shows Namibia’s progress, but it does not settle the teams’ long-term ranking.
disagree.korean: 한 시리즈만으로 두 팀의 장기 순위를 정할 수 없습니다.

cards.english_title: Beatlemania brings Beatles songs across India
cards.korean_desc: 비틀매니아는 2026년 11월 11일 첸나이에서 공연합니다. 유럽 헌정 밴드는 비틀스의 모습과 소리를 재현합니다. 밴드는 벵갈루루와 고아, 하이데라바드를 거쳐 영국으로 돌아갑니다.
cards.english_desc: Beatlemania will perform in Chennai on November 11, 2026. The European tribute band recreates the look, sound, and excitement of The Beatles. It will continue to Bengaluru, Goa, and Hyderabad before returning to Britain.
cards.hook: Beatlemania will tour India in November.
cards.takeaway_english: The tour turns Beatles nostalgia into a live November event across India.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 투어는 비틀스 향수를 인도의 11월 공연으로 만듭니다.

why_it_matters.english: The tour brings a live Beatles-style show to cities beyond corporate events.
why_it_matters.korean: 이번 투어는 기업 행사를 넘어 도시 관객에게 공연을 선물합니다.

why_it_matters.english: Music fans can hear many famous songs in one continuous performance.
why_it_matters.korean: 팬들은 한 공연에서 유명한 노래를 많이 들을 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Beatlemania
parties.english: The European tribute band will perform across Indian cities in November.
parties.korean: 유럽 헌정 밴드가 11월 인도 도시에서 공연합니다.

parties.label: Dave Peterson
parties.english: He started the band in 1992 and says the current cast formed about five years ago.

parties.label: Indian audiences
parties.english: They are expected to know many of the Beatles’ songs.
parties.korean: 인도 관객은 비틀스 노래를 많이 압니다.

views.label: Beatlemania
views.english: The band says Indian audiences know the songs and bring strong energy.
views.korean: 밴드는 인도 관객이 노래를 알고 열정적이라고 말합니다.

views.label: Tribute-band perspective
views.english: A tribute show recreates the sound and look, but it is not the original Beatles.
views.korean: 헌정 공연은 원조 비틀스가 아니라 음악을 재현합니다.

disagree.english: Some listeners may prefer original recordings, while others enjoy the live spectacle.
disagree.korean: 어떤 사람은 원곡을 좋아하고 다른 사람은 라이브를 좋아합니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 헌정 공연과 원곡 중 무엇을 고르겠어요?

cards.english_title: China’s anti-corruption purge shows no clear ending
cards.korean_desc: 중국 공산당은 2026년 10월 29일 베이징 회의를 끝냈습니다. 회의는 더 강한 당 규율과 반부패 활동을 요구했습니다. 고위 인사 33명이 쫓겨났고 장성민은 정치국에 들어갔습니다. 분석가들은 숙청의 주된 목적을 두고 의견이 갈립니다.
cards.english_desc: China’s Communist Party ended a four-day meeting in Beijing on October 29, 2026. The meeting called for stronger party discipline and continued anti-corruption work. Thirty-three officials were expelled, while Zhang Shengmin entered the Politburo. Analysts disagree over whether the purge mainly fights corruption or strengthens Xi’s control.
cards.hook: China’s ruling party is extending its anti-corruption campaign.
cards.takeaway_english: The latest meeting suggests discipline and personnel changes will remain central to Xi’s rule.
cards.takeaway_korean: 최근 회의는 규율과 인사 변화가 계속 중요하다는 뜻입니다.

why_it_matters.english: Leadership purges can affect China’s military decisions and relations with other countries.
why_it_matters.korean: 지도부 숙청은 중국의 군사 결정과 외교에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

why_it_matters.english: Repeated investigations can change who holds power inside one of the world’s strongest states.
why_it_matters.korean: 반복되는 조사는 강대국 중국의 권력 구조를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

parties.label: Xi Jinping
parties.english: He is continuing an anti-corruption drive across political and military institutions.
parties.korean: 시진핑은 정치와 군대에서 반부패 운동을 계속합니다.

parties.label: Chinese Communist Party
parties.english: It approved stronger self-governance and discipline after the October plenum.
parties.korean: 중국 공산당은 더 강한 당 규율을 승인했습니다.

parties.label: Zhang Shengmin
parties.english: The military anti-corruption official was promoted to the Politburo.

views.label: Chinese officials
views.english: They describe the campaign as necessary to remove corruption and strengthen party rule.
views.korean: 중국 당국은 숙청이 부패를 없애고 통치를 강화한다고 말합니다.

views.label: Outside analysts
views.english: They argue the campaign may also remove rivals and prepare Xi for continued rule.
views.korean: 외부 분석가들은 숙청이 경쟁자를 없애고 시진핑의 장기 집권을 준비한다고 봅니다.

disagree.english: The public record cannot fully show whether each case is corruption, political conflict, or both.
disagree.korean: 공개 자료만으로 각 사건의 성격을 모두 알 수는 없습니다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 반부패 운동이 정치적 통제도 키울 수 있을까요?
cards.source_title: The unending purge in Xi’s China

views.label: Chinese Communist Party
views.english: Tighter discipline is presented as a way to strengthen party governance.
views.korean: 중국 공산당은 강한 규율이 통치를 강화한다고 말합니다.

views.label: Outside analysts
views.english: Some analysts see the purges as also strengthening Xi Jinping’s political control.
views.korean: 일부 분석가는 숙청이 시진핑의 통제도 강화한다고 봅니다.

caption_lines: The next Party Congress is expected in the second half of 2027
cards.reader_question: Can an anti-corruption campaign also increase political control?

sources.title: The unending purge in Xi’s China

sentences.english: China’s Communist Party ended a four-day meeting in Beijing on October 29, 2026.
sentences.korean: 중국 공산당은 2026년 10월 29일 베이징 회의를 끝냈습니다.

sentences.english: The meeting called for stronger party discipline and continued anti-corruption work.
sentences.korean: 회의는 더 강한 당 규율과 반부패 활동을 요구했습니다.

sentences.english: Thirty-three officials were expelled, while Zhang Shengmin entered the Politburo.
sentences.korean: 고위 인사 33명이 쫓겨났고 장성민은 정치국에 들어갔습니다.

sentences.english: Analysts disagree over whether the purge mainly fights corruption or strengthens Xi’s control.
sentences.korean: 분석가들은 숙청의 주된 목적을 두고 의견이 갈립니다.

cards.short_english: China’s Communist Party ended a four-day meeting in Beijing on October 29, 2026.
